newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ROOD TESTHOUSE SEES HIGHER 1997 NET PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: ROOD TESTHOUSE SEES HIGHER 1997 NET PROFIT.

text.p: company Rood Testhouse said it expected to post
"It is expected that market conditions in the semiconductors
industry will improve and efforts will be made to profit from
this in 1997," the company said in a statement.
"The result of the French unit is expected to improve. Based
on these expectations the net result will increase," Rood
The company earlier reported full-year 1996 net profits
plunged to 0.16 million guilders from a year-earlier 3.69
million, reflecting substantial losses at its French operations,
a margin squeeze in testing activities and higher operating
costs due to exchange rate effects.
It said that in view of the turbulent market conditions and
its liquidity position, it would not pay a dividend over 1996.
